title: GitHub - Jackalope-Dev/allmcps-server: Official MCP server for AllMCPs.com — submit MCP servers to the directory directly from your AI agent.
excerpt: Official MCP server for AllMCPs.com — submit MCP servers to the directory directly from your AI agent. - Jackalope-Dev/allmcps-server
content_html:
The official local MCP server for AllMCPs.com — search, browse, get install configs for, and submit Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers directly from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent.

This package is a thin stdio bridge to the AllMCPs remote MCP endpoint. Tool behavior lives server-side, so this package always exposes the current live tool set with no need to upgrade the package when a tool is added or changed.

v2.0.0 replaces the single submit_mcp tool with the full tool set below, including a renamed submit_mcp_server (previously submit_mcp). If you depend on the old tool name, pin allmcps-server@1.

Install

Requires Node.js 18+. Add to your MCP client config (e.g. claude_desktop_config.json):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "allmcps": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "allmcps-server"]
    }
  }
}

Tools

Tool Required arguments Description
search_mcp_servers — Search the directory by keyword and/or category.
get_mcp_install_config id Get the install config snippet and docs for a server by ID.
list_mcp_categories — List all categories with server counts.
get_boost_pricing — Get pricing and features for boosting/featuring a listing.
boost_mcp_server id Start a sponsorship/boost order — returns a Stripe checkout URL and x402 invoice.
get_boost_status id Check boost and verified-badge status for a listing.
submit_mcp_server name, url, email Submit a new MCP server to the directory.
verify_mcp_claim id Verify ownership and claim a listing via GitHub README, site badge, or DNS.

submit_mcp_server submissions land in the pending review queue at allmcps.com. The response includes a claim_url and a ready-to-paste badge_markdown snippet — adding that badge to your repo's README verifies the listing instantly instead of waiting on manual review.

Every tool's full input schema (including optional arguments like category, description, sku, and method) is available at runtime via the standard MCP tools/list call, or by inspecting /api/mcp directly.

Configuration

Environment variable Default Purpose
ALLMCPS_MCP_URL https://allmcps.com/api/mcp Override the remote endpoint this package bridges to.

Related

  • Directory API docs: https://allmcps.com/docs/api
  • Remote MCP server (same tools, called directly over HTTP): https://allmcps.com/api/mcp
  • Also listed on the official MCP Registry as io.github.Jackalope-Dev/allmcps-server, Glama, and the LobeHub Marketplace

content_html_zh:
AllMCPs.com 的官方本地 MCP 服务器 — 直接从 Claude、Cursor 或任何 MCP 兼容代理搜索、浏览、获取安装配置并提交模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器。

该软件包是一个连接 AllMCP 远程 MCP 端点的精简 stdio 桥。 工具行为位于服务器端，因此该包始终公开当前的实时工具集，在添加或更改工具时无需升级包。

v2.0.0 用下面的完整工具集替换了单个 Submit_mcp 工具，包括重命名的 Submit_mcp_server（以前的 Submit_mcp）。 如果您依赖旧工具名称，请固定 allmcps-server@1。

安装

需要 Node.js 18+。 添加到您的 MCP 客户端配置（例如 claude_desktop_config.json）：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "allmcps": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "allmcps-server"]
    }
  }
}

Tools

Tool 必需的参数 描述
搜索_mcp_服务器 — 按关键字和/或类别搜索目录。
获取_mcp_安装_配置 id 按 ID 获取服务器的安装配置片段和文档。
列表_mcp_类别 — 列出所有类别以及服务器数量。
获取提升定价 — 获取提升/展示列表的定价和功能。
boost_mcp_服务器 id 启动赞助/促销订单 — 返回 Stripe 结帐 URL 和 x402 发票。
获取升压状态 id 检查列表的增强和验证徽章状态。
提交_mcp_服务器 姓名、网址、电子邮件 将新的 MCP 服务器提交到目录。
验证_mcp_声明 id 通过 GitHub README、站点徽章或 DNS 验证所有权并声明列表。

commit_mcp_server 提交内容进入 allmcps.com 的待审核队列。 响应包括一个claim_url和一个准备粘贴的badge_markdown片段——将该徽章添加到您的存储库的自述文件中可以立即验证列表，而不是等待手动审核。

每个工具的完整输入模式（包括类别、描述、sku 和方法等可选参数）均可在运行时通过标准 MCP 工具/列表调用或直接检查 /api/mcp 获得。

配置

环境变量 默认 目的
ALLMCPS_MCP_URL https://allmcps.com/api/mcp 覆盖此包桥接的远程端点。

有关的

  • 目录 API 文档：https://allmcps.com/docs/api
  • 远程 MCP 服务器（相同的工具，直接通过 HTTP 调用）：https://allmcps.com/api/mcp
  • 还在官方 MCP 注册表中列为 io.github.Jackalope-Dev/allmcps-server、Glama 和 LobeHub Marketplace
